'''Gandalf Greyhame Tatooine Occupation VSC My Style''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Gandalf Greyhame]]
* '''Published:''' 20 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Strategy:''' Imperial Occupation
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 IOcc Greyhame DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck doesn't win by a lot, but it wins 95% of it's games.  The original version of this deck (played by Bastian Winkelhaus and Martin Akkesson) took first and second at Freedom Con (worlds) last year.

== Strategy ==

Editor's Note #1: Yes, that deck is where I got the strategy.  I mentioned that in the description.

Editor's Note #2: If you don't like starting the objective, than swap it out for a Monnok.

Okay, pretty simple and sraight forward.  Just set up the Occupation and Fighters Coming In at Tatooine, strong guys at docking bays with Reacting At-Sts and Tallon Roll or Blast away your opponents starships.  Use your undercover spies to slow the other guys drains.  Like I said, doesn't always win by much, but nearly always wins.  One other things, your destiny average is great, being over three.

ALWAYS REMEMBER THAT YOUR FIRST GAME ACTION SHOULD BE TO PUL CARIDA WITH MOB POINTS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Good luck with it!
